comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: NAV Rs 40.47 on net worth Rs 31.44 cr implies about 77.7 lakh pre-issue shares; EPS Rs 17.81 on PAT Rs 13.42 cr implies a weighted 75.4 lakh, consistent with a small FY26 share issue (net worth rose Rs 17.20 cr against PAT Rs 13.42 cr).

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Objects excluding GCP Rs 41.91 cr (shed 7.89 + plant 9.90 + conductor machinery 6.89 + rooftop solar 3.23 + working capital 14.00) over 28.008 lakh fresh shares = Rs 159 a share after 6% assumed expenses, below the Rs 190 floor.

scorecard.finding: NAV Rs 40.47 on net worth Rs 31.44 cr implies about 77.7 lakh pre-issue shares; EPS Rs 17.81 on PAT Rs 13.42 cr implies a weighted 75.4 lakh, consistent with a small FY26 share issue (net worth rose Rs 17.20 cr against PAT Rs 13.42 cr).

Operating cash flow not available without the RHP. Borrowings rose from Rs 41.79 cr to Rs 79.88 cr in FY26 while total assets nearly doubled (Rs 64.28 cr to Rs 126.64 cr), so growth was largely funded by debt and working capital absorbed most of the profit.
Current vs deferred tax split not available.
Related-party transactions not available without the RHP.

Objects excluding GCP Rs 41.91 cr (shed 7.89 + plant 9.90 + conductor machinery 6.89 + rooftop solar 3.23 + working capital 14.00) over 28.008 lakh fresh shares = Rs 159 a share after 6% assumed expenses, below the Rs 190 floor.
Goodwill and intangibles not available; none reported by trackers.
Customer concentration not available. Two plants, both in Mehsana, Gujarat (79,950 km a year installed).
Contingent liabilities and litigation not available.
Auditor and any qualifications not available.
Fresh issue Rs 56.02 cr: monitoring agency is mandatory above Rs 50 cr; to be named in the RHP.
SME eligibility (operating profit track record, net worth) appears met on the reported numbers; not re-computed from the RHP.
ISK Advisors (sole BRLM, Ahmedabad): track record not compiled in this run.

reverse.sentence: Current free cash flow is negative, so no multiple can be stated: the price assumes cash generation improves from here.

levers.label: Lever 1 - implied perpetual growth on current FCFF
Lever 2 - implied WACC at terminal g
Lever 4 - required NWC % of revenue (steady state)

overhang.label: Promoters' minimum contribution (20% of post-issue capital)

strengths: Revenue CAGR 54% FY24-26 to Rs 210.47 cr
Wide LV range: power, control, building, solar, submersible and welding cables
Two plants in Mehsana, 79,950 km a year installed
weaknesses: Thin cash generation: working capital absorbs profit
Small scale against national cable brands
opportunities: Housing, infrastructure and solar demand for LV cables
Paper-insulated conductors for transformer makers (new line)
threats: Price competition from organised and unorganised makers

adjustments.reason: Rs 0.87 cr of other income (6% of PBT); its nature (interest, scrap, export incentives) is not known without the RHP. Shown for information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +0.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 29.6x reported and 29.6x adjusted.
checked: PAT growth (146%) ahead of revenue growth (50%) is explained by the EBITDA margin rising from 8.68% to 11.43% on a small base; not tested against the notes
Cash tax, capitalised costs, exceptional items and related-party pricing could not be tested without the RHP
